令 \(u=xt\)，则 \(t=\frac{u}{x}\)，\(\mathrm dt=\frac{\mathrm du}{x}\)，且 \(\frac{1}{t}=\frac{x}{u}\)。于是

\[
\int_{x^2}^x \frac{\sin(xt)}{t}\,\mathrm dt
=
\int_{x^3}^{x^2}\frac{\sin u}{u}\,\mathrm du.
\]

当 \(u\to 0\) 时，

\[
\frac{\sin u}{u}=1-\frac{u^2}{6}+O(u^4).
\]

因此

\[
\int_{x^3}^{x^2}\frac{\sin u}{u}\,\mathrm du
=
\int_{x^3}^{x^2}1\,\mathrm du+O\!\left(\int_{x^3}^{x^2}u^2\,\mathrm du\right)
=
x^2-x^3+O(x^6).
\]

所以原极限为

\[
\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x^2-x^3+O(x^6)}{x^2}
=
\lim_{x\to 0}\left(1-x+O(x^4)\right)
=1.
\]

答案：B
